Needs changes before merge.

The code review found no additional defect. One required test result is missing.

What looks good:
- The engine checks macro types and control characters before the lifecycle hooks run.
- Macro text stays literal. Tool-number transitions control macro emission. Repeated TOOL records still call the hook.
- The exact NC assertions check the macro order, repeated tools, and preview attribution.
- No golden file changed. I checked each line of the new expected NC strings.

Local results:
- Head: `4b2f83fee5eee2487cbc9d2da3e47634709e54ed`.
- Base: current `upstream/main`, `e048b103ca649e24048268e1a050f0b4686a997a`.
- The trial merge was already up to date. The worktree had its own target directory.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: PASS. All 134 steps passed in 8.3 minutes. The test runs passed 1,081 tests. One existing test stayed ignored.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: PASS.
- Restored `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-post --test tool_change_macros`: PASS, 11 tests.
- Heavy lanes: NOT RUN. The dry-run selected 184 steps for the app heavy lanes. A dry-run is not a test pass.

Extra suites run:
- No additional fixture-reader or importer suite applies. The diff changes no fixture, golden directory, or importer code.
- The full `tool_change_macros` suite ran again after both mutations were removed: 11 passed.

Safety mutations:
1. Restore the upstream engine: RED. Ten feature and refusal tests failed. The empty-macro test passed.
2. Force macro emission for repeated tool numbers: RED. `repeated_tool_records_preserve_hooks_without_repeating_change_macros` failed.
3. Restore the reviewed code: GREEN. All 11 macro tests passed. The worktree has no source changes.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/post/src/post/engine.rs:113`: Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on the final head. Add the lane names and results to the PR body. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, **Heavy lanes at review**, requires this check. The dry-run reaches every app heavy target because app depends on post. The PR body reports only the quick gate and clippy. The required 184-step heavy plan has no run evidence. Do not count the existing ignored test or the dry-run as a pass.

Notes:
- This is a safety-tier review because the change adds posted G-code.
- No UI file changed. Before/after screenshots do not apply.
- No process file, build script, workflow, or dependency changed.
- The PR stays a draft until the required heavy results are available.
